data.body:
[P2] Include combinator inputs that started earlier

Durable steps start when called, before their promises are awaited. Start a failing step, await a separate preparation step, then pass the still-running first promise to `context.promise.all` or `race`: its start timestamp precedes the combinator, so this condition excludes the actual failure source. The step reports `PaymentError`, but the combinator and execution report `StepError`. Allow earlier-started inputs whose execution overlaps the combinator instead of treating their start time as proof of a handled failure, and add staggered-start live/replay coverage.
